qualification_basis: Existing ProductIdentityTrustV1 history decisions and source-reverified accepted entity admissions, plus unchanged API-Football fixtures normalizer ResultObservationV2 / FINISHED / REGULATION_90. This audit inspects and measures existing qualification owners; it adds no registry or admission rule.

targets.inclusions: Direct reported FT team goals including regulation added time. Exact reported FT status and elapsed 90; no extra-time or shootout values.
targets.completeness: Both integer goal values present and match score.fulltime and the exact accepted history decision.
targets.missingness: Missing/invalid values fail existing native parser/normalizer; no zero defaults.
targets.corrections: Source revisions and normalized artifacts remain immutable; changed bytes create new evidence and cannot change this frozen hash.
targets.feature_eligibility: Not eligible as pre-match inputs to the same fixture.

targets.blocker: Direct halftime fields retained; existing API-Football fixture normalizer does not emit a separately qualified PeriodScoreObservation for this resource. No inferred second-half labels.
These selected exact fixture resources contain no target-specific statistics/disciplinary evidence. StatsBomb event totals are not promoted to market aggregates without complete semantic proof.

chronology.identity_scope: Retrospective label cutoff, not a pre-kickoff mapping claim.

research.question: Do API-Football FT fixtures provide regulation results and absolute kickoff evidence?
competing_explanations: Treat any finished score as regulation
Require native FT, fulltime/goals equality and absent extra-time/shootout values
research.observed: Official documentation separates FT, AET and PEN and documents date/timezone and score breakdown. Retained UTC dates agree with epoch timestamps on all five fixtures.
research.selected: Audit only direct FT regulation pairs using existing versioned normalization; no sportsbook-equivalence claim.
research.reason: Exact source field, period, identity and time agreement without inferred timezone or scoring totals.
research.tests: 15 branch-oriented source/history checks, 6 existing qualification regressions, real retained replay.
research.remaining_uncertainty: Broader statistics, first-half target normalization, settlement equivalence, player exposure and scientific sufficiency remain unqualified.

verification.red: Two expected failures (date-only history and contradictory timezone metadata) before correction.
